kind: SYNTHETIC evaluation examples, authored for a smoke test; NOT CFPB records or a representative benchmark

cases.narrative: A stranger stole my social security number and opened a loan in my name. I never applied for it and never gave permission.
Someone stole my bank card and used it to buy things. None of those purchases were approved by me.
The bureau lists my mortgage as delinquent even though it has always been paid on time. I want my credit file corrected.
My credit history contains an inaccurate balance. The credit bureau rejected my dispute without checking the evidence.
I paid the full balance on time, but the bank added a late payment fee and additional interest. Please reverse the billing error.
The bank took my monthly installment twice. I need the duplicate debit returned and the balance adjusted.
A collection agency calls my employer every day demanding that I repay a debt. They refuse to send validation.
The collector threatened to sue unless I paid immediately. I asked for proof of the debt and told them to stop calling.
My bank froze my savings account. I cannot withdraw my own money and every attempt to sign in fails.
I am locked out of online banking and unable to use my funds. The bank refuses to restore my access.
The support representative gives confusing instructions and nobody can explain the application process. I need clear information.
Customer service has not sent the documents I requested. Every agent transfers me to someone else without answering my question.
